cases.explain: After the noun "раб" (servant), genitive shows possession or relationship.

reading.ru: Вот я стою здесь, я и дети, которых дал мне Господь.
reading.question: What does the servant say in this verse?
options: Here I am with the children God has given Me
I am leaving with my children
reading.correct: Here I am with the children God has given Me
reading.explain: "Вот я стою здесь, я и дети, которых дал мне Господь" — Behold, I and the children whom God has given Me.

reading.question: What does the Lord give?
reading.explain: "Дал Господь слово слуге его" — The Lord has given me an instructed tongue.

reading.ru: Я раб Господа, кому я служу верно.
reading.question: What is the speaker's relationship to God?
options: A faithful servant of the Lord
A merchant who trades with the Lord
reading.correct: A faithful servant of the Lord
reading.explain: "Я раб Господа" — I am a servant of the Lord.

reading.ru: Кто изо вас боится Господа, слушает голос раба его?
reading.question: Whom does God address in this question?
options: Those who fear the Lord and listen to His servant
reading.correct: Those who fear the Lord and listen to His servant
reading.explain: God asks "Кто...боится Господа" — Who among you fears the Lord and obeys His servant.

reading.ru: Кто идет во тьме без света, верит имени Господа и уповает на Бога.
reading.question: What does the righteous one do in darkness?
options: Trusts in the Lord and relies on God
reading.correct: Trusts in the Lord and relies on God
reading.explain: Even in darkness, the righteous one trusts in God's name and relies on Him.

reading.ru: Вот вы все, разжигающие огонь и опоясывающиеся головнями.
reading.question: To whom is God speaking in judgment?
options: Those who create their own light instead of trusting God
reading.correct: Those who create their own light instead of trusting God
reading.explain: God condemns those who rely on their own works instead of His word.
